extDescription.message: Your Aplica companion for preparing job applications. Free.

connectIntro.message: Connect this browser to your Aplica account. Aplica does not read any page until you ask it to.

connecting.message: Waiting for you to approve the connection…

noticeRevoked.message: The connection has been closed. Connect again to keep using Aplica.

errorDenied.message: You did not allow the connection.

errorInvalid.message: The connection could not be completed. Please try again.

errorNetwork.message: Could not reach Aplica. Check your connection and try again.

errorRateLimited.message: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.

errorServer.message: Aplica is not responding as expected. Please try again later.

previewIntro.message: Check what Aplica has read from the page. You can correct it before you save. Saving is free.

fieldInvalid.message: This field is not valid. Check it.

needsSelection.message: Select the job posting text on the page and press “Use the selected text”.

noAccess.message: Click the Aplica icon on this page to read the job posting.

unsupportedPage.message: Open a job posting on a web page to save it.

readFailed.message: The page could not be read. Please try again.

noticeTruncated.message: The description was too long and has been shortened to $MAX$ characters.

noticeFromSelection.message: The description is the text you had selected on the page.

errorScope.message: This connection does not allow saving job postings. Disconnect and connect again.

possibleDuplicate.message: You already have a similar application: $TITLE$ at $COMPANY$. It may be the same job posting with a different link.

savedText.message: $TITLE$ at $COMPANY$ is in your account as a saved application.

duplicateTitle.message: You already have this job posting in Aplica

devExportWarning.message: Development only. The file contains personal data and the page's real content: do not share it outside the project.

devExportDone.message: File downloaded. Save it in fixtures-raw/.

devExportError.message: The page could not be exported. Click the Aplica icon on it and try again.
